_note: The recorded walkthrough videos (issue #49), in ASD-STE100. Each video is a recording of a 3D replay clip (issue #48). The files are public/videos/<id>-<size>.webm, one for each size. To record them again, run npm run videos (see README.md).

videos.title: How to play Jumper
videos.caption: Put a part on the board, connect a wire, read the pop-up, then press Check.

videos.title: Perch level 1 · Set up the board
videos.caption: See the board on two breadboards, and the wires that give the breadboards power.

videos.title: Perch level 2 · Talk button and status light
videos.caption: See the button, the resistor and the small light go on the board, and the wires that connect them.

videos.title: Perch level 3 · Ears
videos.caption: See the tiny microphone go on the board, and the wires that connect it.

videos.title: Perch level 4 · Voice
videos.caption: See the amplifier and the speaker go on the board, and the wires that connect them.

videos.title: Perch level 5 · Face
videos.caption: See the small screen go on the board, and the wires that connect it.
